method: Independent factory-reset procedural builds in Blender 5.3.0 (also tried with -t 1). Compared per-primitive vertex counts, triangle counts and the full set of vertex positions rounded to 10 micrometres.
note: The exact Boolean solver emits vertices/triangles in a run-dependent order, so GLB bytes differ between builds while the shape is the same. The baked normal-map PNG matched for this compared pair, but across four runs it came out with one of two hashes (sub-pixel bake noise), so texture byte identity is not guaranteed either.
